status: LOCKED v3 (client redesign, 2026-06). Pure-white luxury editorial. No dark mode.

usage_rules: Deep Navy (#0D1B2A) = primary text + primary buttons (white text).
Royal Blue (#1E4FA8) = links, active states, chart primary line.
Champagne Gold (#C7A247) = SPARING accent only (thin dividers, active indicator, small marks, secondary-button border/icon). Never a large fill.
Backgrounds pure white or warm white #FAF9F6. Borders hairline #E7E7E7. Soft shadows only.

layout.style: Editorial, large whitespace, luxury spacing, section spacing 100-140px.

components.header: White, thin bottom border, logo left, nav center, language switch + navy Sign In right, sticky, premium spacing.

buttons.primary: Deep Navy background, white text, rounded-lg, large.
buttons.secondary: White background, gold border, gold icon, navy text.

components.cards: White, soft shadow, thin border, large padding, rounded (14px).
components.home_hero: Content left (title/subtitle/CTA unchanged) + large bright luxury gemstone photography right (cut diamond / blue sapphire / white diamond). Bright studio lighting, no dark overlays.

admin.sidebar: Deep Navy, logo top, minimal thin-stroke icons, gold active menu indicator, no gradients/transparency.
admin.topbar: White, minimal — search, notifications, profile, premium spacing.
admin.cards: White, soft shadow, rounded, luxury spacing.
admin.charts: White background, royal-blue primary line, gold secondary line, minimal grid (introduced in analytics sprint).

icons.usage: Minimal, thin stroke, gold or navy, consistent size.

images.direction: Bright high-end cut diamonds / blue sapphire / white diamond / luxury jewelry on bright studio backgrounds. No dark overlays, no raw mineral/purple crystals.

motion.policy: Restrained: soft hover elevation + existing color transitions only. No new animations, no grain.

instructions_to_main_agent: Light theme only; tokens in src/index.css (:root) + tailwind.config.js (navy primary, royal, gold).
Royal blue for interactive/active; gold strictly sparing.
Keep routing, component structure, API, auth, RBAC, and business logic unchanged (visual-only redesign).
